content.value: An instruction in address (OAC)16 in the computer has the operation-code of ADD instruction and an address part is (1CD)16. The memory word of address (1CD)16 contains (1CBF)16. Register A contains $( 1 0 1 0 ) _ { 1 6 }$ Tabulate the contents of register $\mathbb { P C } , \mathbb { M A R } , \mathbb { B } , \mathbb { A }$ and I after the instruction is executed. Repeat the problem two more times for operations AND and STO.
